message: Hey Jane, hope your morning has been good! Anything interesting happen at work today?
Jane, I've sent the documents for the Patterson case to your email. Please review them before our 2 PM meeting.
Reminder: The team meeting is rescheduled to 4 PM today.
Good morning Jane! Just a heads-up, Mr. Thompson called and he'll be late for his appointment.
Don't forget we have dinner plans with the Wilsons this Friday!
Jane, the coffee machine is broken again. Can you believe it?
All staff, please update your timesheets by EOD Wednesday.
Good luck with your meetings today, love!
Thanks, Mark! I'll need it, big day ahead.
Jane, remember to bring the Henderson file to the office today.
